checklists.name: IBM DB2 Engineering Standards
checklists.description: Validation checklist for DB2 SQL dialect, isolation levels, index optimization, and REORG/RUNSTATS maintenance.

items.statement: SQL queries explicitly specify necessary isolation levels (e.g. Cursor Stability CS, Read Stability RS) to prevent lock contention.
Index cardinality and column ordering are optimized to avoid DB2 lock escalation and table-level locks.
db2expln utility is run to inspect access paths and ensure index scan vs table scan choices align with volume expectations.
REORG and RUNSTATS maintenance schedules are defined for high-churn DB2 tablespaces.
Prepared statements with parameter markers are used for all dynamic SQL invocations.
